changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.7: GLOBAL > AUDIO ROUTING > DAC SUM routes every voice through the DAC, and FILTER pressed twice opens DAC FILTER, a per-voice filter, transient shaper and polarity reached through core-ar2's page tables.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
